I'm organizing our company launch event and I'm interested in hiring the Hartwell Kestrel. We plan to pick it up on 08/03/2027 at 10:30 am and return it by 9th March 2027 at 9.00am. To confirm, the pick-up date will be Mon 22 Mar 2027. Could you deliver it to the Saltmarsh Lighthouse Hotel and then collect it from there afterwards? We also require it to be driven by a chauffeur. 

Cheers,
Jasper Ashgrove
+70 416 150 1549
